Alex Martinez: Heads up: we’re launching an *internal beta* of our new **Quickstart Templates (RAG + Agents)** today. Goal is to get honest feedback before we go public.

What you get in this beta:
• Python + TypeScript templates (RAG baseline + simple agent loop w/ tool calling)
• Safe defaults (timeouts/retries/backoff, max tokens, tool output limits, max agent iterations)
• Built-in observability (OpenTelemetry traces + structured logs, plus “template-friendly” span attrs)
• A tiny CLI to scaffold + validate your env (`init` + `doctor`)

Repo + docs (internal):
• https://github.com/redwood/redwood-quickstarts (branch: `internal-beta`)
• Docs draft: https://docs.redwood-inference.internal/quickstarts/templates (WIP)

How to try it (10–15 min):
1) Clone repo
2) Install CLI:
   - `cd cli && pip install -e .` (python)
   - or `pnpm i && pnpm link --global` (ts) (see README)
3) Scaffold a project:
   - `redwood-templates init rag-agent-python`
   - or `redwood-templates init rag-agent-typescript`
4) Set env vars:
   - `REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`
   - `REDWOOD_MODEL=...` (default pinned model is in `.env.example`)
   - optional: `REDWOOD_TEMPLATE_TELEMETRY=off` (see note below)
5) Run checks:
   - `redwood-templates doctor`
6) Start it:
   - `make dev` or `pnpm dev`

Where to give feedback:
• Reply in-thread here (quick thoughts welcome)
• #devex (longer discussion)
• File issues in the repo (preferred for actionable bugs): https://github.com/redwood/redwood-quickstarts/issues
• If it’s support-facing / “this will break customers”, tag @Priya Shah and @Christine Wong

Known limitations in this beta (please read):
• **Telemetry tagging is opt-in**. We add a lightweight “template origin” tag/header for adoption KPIs, but some proxies reject unknown headers. Default is OFF in internal beta unless you enable it.
• **Streaming behind certain proxies** can still disconnect. We added retry/backoff + reconnect logic, but we want more real-world data.
• **Vector store adapters are intentionally minimal**. Local default + one placeholder adapter. Don’t expect production parity yet.
• **No in-place upgrade story** (yet). Treat this as “generate once” for now.
• **OTel exporter config can be confusing** if you don’t run the local collector. We ship `docker-compose` for local dev; production wiring is WIP.
• Please don’t use real customer docs/PII in your test corpus. The templates include log redaction, but we still want to keep internal beta clean.

If you can spare time this week: we’d love 2 data points from each tester:
1) Time to first successful answer in RAG flow
2) Did you see useful traces/metrics without tweaking anything?

Thanks — this is a big DevEx push and we need the internal gauntlet. :pray:

— Alex

Redwood Deploy Bot: Build `redwood-quickstarts@internal-beta` ✅  
Artifacts: `cli@0.3.0-beta.2`, `templates@0.3.0-beta.2`

Monica Patel: Adding 2 quick notes:
1) If `doctor` fails on “collector not reachable”, you can either `docker compose up` from the template root *or* set `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=none` for a quick “no-otel” run.
2) Please paste *sanitized* logs only (API keys get redacted but still 🙏)

Dana Lo: TS template testers: we’re particularly interested in any weirdness around tool-call parsing + streaming events. If you hit a case where the agent loop gets stuck, grab the trace id + open an issue.

Wei Chen: Docs feedback also welcome. The README structure is being standardized across templates — if you find a step confusing, comment in the repo issue and tag me.

Allison Grant: Observability specifics for the curious:
• Expect spans: `http.server` → `redwood.request` → `rag.retrieve` → `rag.rerank` (optional) → `llm.generate` → `agent.tool` (if tools)
• Minimal attributes to look for: `redwood.request_id`, `llm.model`, `llm.stream=true/false`, `rag.top_k`
If any of those are missing in your run, please flag.

Christine Wong: SRE lens: please call out anything that feels like a footgun in defaults (timeouts too aggressive, retries too many, noisy logs). We want “safe by default” even if it’s slightly slower.

Sahana Iyer: FYI CI is still a bit flaky on streaming smoke tests. If you see test failures in your fork, re-run once before assuming it’s real. We’re tightening timeouts.

Priya Shah: Support POV: if you hit common errors (401/429/timeouts/tool schema), note the exact message + what you expected. We’re building the troubleshooting page off these.

Talia Benson: If anyone wants to be a designated “beta captain” for 30 mins, DM me. We’re trying to get coverage across macOS/Linux + a couple different corp proxy setups.

Renee Sullivan: I’m going to try this end-to-end and record a quick internal loom (setup + common gotchas). Drop questions you want me to cover.

Ibrahim Khan: Also: if you’re testing with super low rate limits, set concurrency to 1 in the template config. We’d rather see “works reliably” than “fast and fails”.

Elliot Price: For docs reviewers: please focus on IA clarity (where do templates live vs SDK guides) + whether “RAG vs agent vs workflow” wording is confusing. We’re trying to avoid overloading “agents.”

Alex Martinez: :thumbsup: Appreciate everyone jumping in. Keep feedback coming — we’ll do a quick triage sync Friday and decide what’s blocker vs defer.
